title: underdraw add and underdraw edit
description:
Create and edit items as the user.

- `underdraw add project|feature|task <title>` with `--project` / `--feature` and `--description` (or `-` / an editor for long markdown). Prints the new ID. User-created features are ready, not drafts; add `--draft` to create an idea.
- `underdraw edit <id>` for title, description and parent. The CLI fetches the current revision itself and reports a revision conflict clearly.
- `underdraw note <id> <body>` adds a decision note.
